antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in chondrocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Gentle regeneration: 345 THz (870nm) at low power, continuous, targets neuron mitochondria targeting NO_synthase in chondrocyte. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows NO modulation at 635nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_I_NADH activation.
